content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notification lists 22 vacancies in total. They are distributed across 10 blocks of Thoothukudi district. Alwarthirunagari, Kayathar, Kovilpatti and Pudur have the highest number of posts, with 3 vacancies each. Category-wise or reservation-wise vacancy details are not specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification gives only one clear deadline. The application start date is not mentioned, and no date for the exam or interview is announced yet.

rows.date: Will be informed separately to eligible applicants

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet all of the following conditions given in the notification. Gender: Women candidates only. Residence: The applicant must be a resident of the block in Thoothukudi district where the vacancy is available. Age: Must have completed 18 years and must not be above 35 years, as on 1 July 2026. Qualification: Must meet the educational and computer skill requirements explained in the next section. Driving licence: Must hold a licence for a two-wheeler (இருசக்கர வாகனம்). Experience: Must have a minimum of five years of experience in people's organisation-based projects (மக்கள் அமைப்பு சார்ந்த திட்டங்கள்).

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Qualification
content_sections.text: The notification mentions an undergraduate degree (இளங்கலை பட்டம்) and computer skills. A candidate must satisfy one of the two options below. The specific degree name for Option 1 is not specified; the notification refers to an undergraduate degree in general.

rows.details: A pass in an undergraduate degree, plus a certificate course in computer MS Office of at least 3 months.
A pass in an undergraduate degree in Computer Science or Computer Application.
Preference will be given to candidates who have an educational qualification related to computer software.
Must hold a licence for a two-wheeler.
Minimum five years of experience in people's organisation-based projects.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is calculated as on 1 July 2026. Candidates must have completed 18 years and must be within a maximum age of 35 years.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Salary
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated monthly payment of ₹12,000, along with a travel allowance of ₹750, making a total of ₹12,750. The notification does not state whether this amount is paid per month. The contract period is also not specified.

content_sections.heading: TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification refers to an exam/interview (தேர்வு/நேர்காணல்) for eligible applicants, and says the date will be informed to them separately. The number of stages, exam pattern, syllabus, marking scheme and final merit method are not specified. Key points about selection from the notification: Only eligible applicants will be informed of the exam/interview date. No travel allowance is given for attending the exam or interview. Applications that are ineligible, incomplete, contain wrong information or arrive after the deadline will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TNSRLM Thoothukudi Block Coordinator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notification describes an offline process. Candidates must submit a completed application form along with copies of the relevant certificates. Download the post details and application form from the official website www.thoothukudi.nic.in . Fill in every detail in the application form completely. Incomplete forms and forms with wrong information will be rejected. Attach copies of supporting certificates for qualification, residence, caste, good conduct, computer training and preference (முன்னுரிமை). Submit the application in person on government working days between 10:00 AM and 5:45 PM, or send it by registered post. Make sure the application reaches the office by 5:45 PM on 16 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Tamil Nadu State Rural Livelihoods Mission Thoothukudi (TNSRLM Thoothukudi) for filling vacant positions in various blocks.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised under this notification?
faq.answer: The advertised position is Block Coordinator across multiple blocks in the Thoothukudi district under advertisement number A5/397/2025.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available in TNSRLM Thoothukudi recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 22 vacancies available for the Block Coordinator post distributed across different block locations within Thoothukudi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates must download the form, fill it out, attach required documents, and send it by post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed offline application form is 16-10-2026 by 5:45 PM to the designated district management unit address.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Block Coordinator?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an undergraduate degree with a Computer MS Office 3 months certificate course or a Computer Science/Application degree along with a driving license.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any work experience required for this job?
faq.answer: Yes, applicants must have a minimum of 5 years of experience working in people organization-related projects to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for applying to TNSRLM Thoothukudi?
faq.answer: The age limit for applicants is between 18 and 35 years as calculated on 01-07-2026. Specific relaxations may apply as per government rules.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary offered for the Block Coordinator position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a total consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 12,750/-, which includes a consolidated pay and travel allowance.

faq.question: Q10. Where should I send the filled application form?
faq.answer: The application must be sent via registered post to the Joint Director/Project Director, District Management Unit, District Collectorate, Thoothukudi.
